title: Transverse federated learning training method capable of improving system fairness under sensitive scene
assignee: Shenzhen International Graduate School of Tsinghua University

pse.problem: Inadequate system fairness due to heterogeneous data distribution and size across multiple clients in federal learning, leading to decreased accuracy and extended training time.
pse.solution_function: Improves system fairness in a sensitive scene by implementing a transverse federated learning method that guarantees best performance while maintaining fairness. The method aims to relieve potential conflicts between clients before the average gradient is distributed, using maximum minimum optimization.
pse.solution_structure: The method consists of multiple clients with local models and a server for aggregating parameters. Fairness is used as a resource for allocation in this system.
pse.solution_implementation: The method trains local models on individual client data, then transmits model parameters to the server. The server aggregates these parameters using maximum minimum optimization, ensuring overall fairness without sacrificing client performances. Conflicts between clients are relieved before the average gradient is distributed.
pse.effect: Improves system fairness across clients while maintaining performance levels, allowing for better predictions in sensitive scenarios and reducing the potential for biased outcomes.
